battle.name: 嘉山之戰
battle.theater: 河北道恆州曲陽縣東嘉山
battle.brief: 天寶十五載（756年）五月廿九，朔方節度使郭子儀與河東節度使李光弼在常山郡東的嘉山，擊潰史思明合軍五萬餘眾，斬首四萬級。卡面的亞述長矛代表短柄長刃、密集列陣的刺擊譜系，唐軍對應的是步卒方槊與陌刀長柄陣，騎兵五百先輪番誘敵疲之，再以大陣壓上決戰。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 嘉山之戰是安史之亂中唐軍在河北道中部贏下的一場野戰，時間在天寶十五載（756年）五月，交戰地點在恆州曲陽縣東的嘉山，緊貼太行山東麓。交戰一方是唐朝的兩鎮行營：朔方節度使郭子儀所部與河東節度使李光弼所部。唐軍在常山郡、恆陽一線設營，兵馬多為朔方、河東兩鎮的鎮兵與沿途徵集的團練，編制上分為步軍與騎軍，另有護送草料的輜重車隊，糧秣靠常山、恆陽一線的州縣供應，李光弼部亦收編了同羅、曳落河等部族的騎兵。另一方是安祿山建立的大燕河北部隊，主將史思明，其麾下多為安祿山起兵時的河北主力。安祿山又從洛陽派大將蔡希德率步騎兵二萬北上回援，命范陽郡守將牛廷玠徵發范陽等郡兵萬餘人南下，企圖與史思明合軍夾擊唐軍。燕軍合兵後總數在五萬餘人，其中同羅、曳落河精騎約一萬人，是其突擊主力。燕軍的糧秣靠范陽、博陵一線的據點供給，唐軍則控制常山、恆陽，正卡在范陽通往洛陽的通道上，這條通道一斷，河北與河南的叛軍兵馬就再無接應。
countriesEn: The Battle of Jiashan was a field engagement won by Tang forces in the middle of Hebei during the An Lushan rebellion, fought in the fifth month of the fifteenth year of Tianbao (756) at Jiashan, east of the county seat of Quyang in Hengzhou, close against the eastern foot of the Taihang range. On one side stood the field armies of two Tang regional commands: the troops of Shuofang jiedushi Guo Ziyi and those of Hedong jiedushi Li Guangbi. The Tang army was encamped along the line of Changshan commandery and Hengyang, its men drawn mostly from the frontier garrisons of the Shuofang and Hedong circuits together with tuan-lian levied on the way, organised into foot and horse units and accompanied by a baggage train that escorted fodder, while grain came from the prefectures along the Changshan–Hengyang line; Li Guangbi's command likewise counted mounted contingents of the Tongluo and Yiluohe peoples. On the other side stood the Hebei army of the Great Yan state proclaimed by An Lushan, commanded by Shi Siming, whose host grew largely out of the Hebei forces that had risen with An Lushan in 755. An Lushan further sent the general Cai Xide back from Luoyang with twenty thousand foot and horse to reinforce Shi Siming, and ordered Niu Tingjie, commander of Fanyang prefecture, to muster more than ten thousand men from Fanyang and the neighbouring prefectures and send them south, so as to converge on the Tang army from two sides. Once merged, the Yan forces numbered more than fifty thousand men, of whom about ten thousand were picked Tongluo and Yiluohe cavalry forming the spearhead of their attack. The Yan army drew its food and fodder from its strongholds along the Fanyang–Boling line, while the Tang held Changshan and Hengyang and stood squarely on the road that connected Fanyang with Luoyang; once that road was cut, the rebel troops in Hebei and in Henan could no longer support one another.
people: 唐軍方面的策劃者是朔方節度使郭子儀。四月九門之戰大敗史思明部將李立節之後，他與李光弼一路追擊史思明到博陵郡。史思明收拾散兵固守城池，唐軍攻城十日不能下，五月只得撤圍，退回常山郡。史思明見唐軍退走，立刻率數萬人馬追來，郭子儀於是選出騎兵五百人，走走停停、輪番誘敵，拖了三天到行唐，等到叛軍人困馬乏、退避收隊，才回軍反擊，在沙河一線擊敗史思明所部。河東節度使李光弼是唐軍的另一半支柱，追擊與包抄多由他主持，嘉山一戰之後他乘勝再圍博陵。燕軍主將史思明自安祿山起兵以來一直負責河北方面的戰事，嘉山落敗時他在亂中跌下馬來，披髮赤足、拖著斷槍逃回本營，隨即退往博陵。安祿山在洛陽得到敗訊，先遣從河北逃回洛陽的大將蔡希德率步騎兵二萬回援，又命范陽守將牛廷玠率兵萬餘人南下，想合兵夾擊郭子儀。史思明在河北的處境同樣牽動安祿山與謀士高尚、嚴莊的爭議：安祿山大罵這兩名謀士，召集謀臣重新議事，而叛軍的家眷多在范陽，河北連敗之下，軍心浮動。
peopleEn: On the Tang side the man who planned the campaign was Guo Ziyi, jiedushi of Shuofang. After beating Shi Siming's general Li Lijie in the Battle of Jiumen in the fourth month, he and Li Guangbi pursued Shi Siming as far as Boling commandery. Shi Siming gathered his scattered men and shut himself in the walls; the Tang siege lasted ten days without taking the city, so in the fifth month they had to lift the siege and fall back to Changshan commandery. The moment the Tang army withdrew, Shi Siming followed it with tens of thousands of men and horses, and Guo Ziyi answered by selecting five hundred cavalry who moved forward and stopped by turns in relays, drawing the rebels on for three days back towards Xingtang, until the enemy was exhausted and fell back in disorder; only then did he turn and strike, breaking part of Shi Siming's force along the Shahe. Li Guangbi, jiedushi of Hedong, was the other pillar of the Tang army, and it was he who led the pursuit and the enveloping movements; after Jiashan he rode on the victory to besiege Boling once more. Shi Siming, the Yan commander in Hebei, had run the northern front ever since the rebellion began, and when he lost at Jiashan he fell from his horse in the confusion, went bareheaded and barefoot, dragged his broken spear back to his camp, and then withdrew towards Boling. In Luoyang, An Lushan received the news of the defeat: he sent Cai Xide, who had fled back from Hebei to Luoyang, with twenty thousand foot and horse to the rescue, and ordered Niu Tingjie of Fanyang to lead more than ten thousand men south, hoping the two armies would merge and fall on Guo Ziyi. The state of Shi Siming's position in Hebei also fed the argument between An Lushan and his advisers Gao Shang and Yan Zhuang: An Lushan abused the two of them, called his strategists together again to deliberate, and since so many of the rebels' families were in Fanyang, the army's morale grew unsteady as the defeats in Hebei mounted.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長矛是公元前九世紀兩河流域的短柄長刃刺槍，配著鐵鏃，靠密集長柄陣向前衝刺把城邑一個接一個攻下。它在唐軍與燕軍的對決裡，對應的是同一條技術譜系的另兩個環節：亞述的短柄重刃刺擊，唐代則發展出更長的方槊、陌刀與長矛。史思明的燕軍裝備以騎兵為主，同羅、曳落河精騎披馬鎧、用環首刀與長柄槍，衝鋒時先以投槍與彎刀逼近，再下馬步戰；唐軍的騎兵同樣以長刀、方天戟、標槍為主，配以數量不多的弓箭手與蹶張弩手，負責騷擾與遲滯敵軍，而不是正面衝鋒。真正決定嘉山勝負的裝備，是唐軍的輜重車隊與野戰器械：護草料的車隊在行軍中按方陣編組，車上兵員以長槊、陌刀護住車側；郭子儀營中則築深溝高壘，列大盾、拒馬以固營，夜里用火把、短兵與營具襲擾敵營，使燕軍不得休息。蹶張弩、床弩與小型投石機則負責遠程壓制密集隊形，在攻城與野戰中都不可缺少。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card is a short-hafted, broad-bladed thrusting weapon from the ninth century BCE Mesopotamia, fitted with an iron head, and it was what took city after city down as dense ranks of long-hafted spears advanced. Within the clash between the Tang and the Yan, it stands for two other links in the same technical line: the Assyrian short-hafted heavy-thrusting spear had as its Tang counterpart the longer fang shao, the modao and the long spear. Shi Siming's Yan army was mounted in character, and the picked Tongluo and Yiluohe cavalry fought in horse armour with ring-pommel sabres and long-shafted spears, closing the distance with javelins and curved blades before dismounting to fight on foot. Tang cavalry likewise carried long sabres, the fangtian ji and javelins, backed by a small number of archers and crossbowmen whose task was to harass and slow the enemy rather than to charge home. The equipment that actually decided the outcome at Jiashan, however, was the Tang baggage train and its field works: the wagons carrying fodder were formed up in a square as they marched, with spearmen and modao troopers guarding the flanks of the vehicles, while in Guo Ziyi's camp the soldiers dug deep trenches and raised high ramparts, planting large shields and caltrops along the front, and by night went out with torches, short weapons and camp gear to raid the enemy positions so that the Yan army was never allowed to rest. Drawn-cord crossbows, bed crossbows and small traction trebuchets provided long-range pressure against the densely packed formations, and were indispensable both in siege work and in the field.
tactics: 嘉山之戰的戰術主線是「以逸待勞、疲敵而後決戰」。四月九門之戰之後，唐軍一路追擊史思明到博陵郡，史思明收攏散兵固守城池，唐軍以步卒圍攻，十日不能下，五月遂撤圍退回常山郡。史思明見唐軍退兵，立刻率數萬人馬追來，郭子儀不與他硬碰，選出騎兵五百人輪流前出，走走停停地誘敵追擊，用三天時間把叛軍從博陵方向拖到行唐，等到燕軍人困馬乏、後退收隊，才回軍反擊，在沙河一線擊破其部。退回常山後，郭子儀又命士卒深溝高壘，固守營壘而不與叛軍直接交鋒：白天列陣揚威耀兵，讓燕軍以為唐軍將要出擊，夜晚則遣小股奇兵夜襲敵營，燒擾不斷，燕軍疲於應付，人困馬乏。五月二十九日，燕軍因援軍到而重整兵力、追進到恆陽，唐軍乘其疲憊出城列陣，在嘉山正面交戰，一戰而勝。史思明在亂中墜馬，披髮赤足、拖著斷槍逃回本營，隨即退保博陵，李光弼乘勝追擊再圍博陵，郭子儀則準備北上直取范陽，切斷燕軍根本。
tacticsEn: The tactical thread running through the Battle of Jiashan was to wait at ease, wear the enemy out, and then fight the decisive action. After the victory at Jiumen in the fourth month the Tang army pursued Shi Siming to Boling commandery; Shi Siming gathered his scattered men and shut himself inside the walls, the Tang besieged it on foot for ten days without breaching it, and in the fifth month they lifted the siege and withdrew to Changshan commandery. As soon as the Tang army retired, Shi Siming followed with tens of thousands of men and horses, and Guo Ziyi refused to be pinned down: he chose five hundred cavalry who went out in relays, moving forward and stopping by turns to draw the rebel pursuit along, and in three days dragged the Yan army back from the direction of Boling towards Xingtang, waiting until the enemy was tired out and had fallen back before turning and striking, breaking part of Shi Siming's force along the Shahe. Back at Changshan, Guo Ziyi ordered his men to dig deep trenches and raise high ramparts, holding the camp and declining to meet the rebels in open battle: by day they paraded in array and made a show of force so that the Yan army would believe the Tang were about to attack, and by night small detachments of picked men raided the enemy camp, keeping the fires burning, so that the Yan troops were forever busy answering alarms and their men and horses grew exhausted. On the twenty-ninth day of the fifth month, the Yan army, reorganised after its reinforcements had arrived and pressing on to Hengyang, was met in the open field at Jiashan by the Tang army, which had waited for exactly this moment, and was routed in a single engagement. Shi Siming fell from his horse amid the confusion, went bareheaded and barefoot, dragged his broken spear back to his own camp and then withdrew to Boling; Li Guangbi followed up the victory and besieged Boling again, and Guo Ziyi prepared to march north on Fanyang itself and cut the rebels at the root.
data: 與本戰直接相關的數字，以《資治通鑑》與《舊唐書》所述為準。時序：安史之亂爆發於天寶十四載（755年）十一月；天寶十五載（756年）正月安祿山在洛陽稱帝，建立大燕；同年四月郭子儀、李光弼於九門之戰大敗史思明部將李立節；五月唐軍圍博陵郡十日不能下而撤圍，五月二十九日在嘉山交戰，決戰後河北形勢迅速逆轉，六月初七唐軍在潼關兵敗、玄宗西幸長安。兵力：燕軍方面，史思明本部、蔡希德所率步騎兵二萬、牛廷玠所發范陽等郡兵萬餘人合兵，總數五萬餘人，其中同羅、曳落河精騎約一萬人；唐軍方面，誘敵階段郭子儀只出騎兵五百人，決戰時由郭子儀、李光弼兩軍主力出城作戰，另有舊史記載可資徵發的河北各郡響應兵與援軍五萬餘人，具體編制從缺。戰果：斬首四萬級，俘虜千餘人，繳獲戰馬五百匹。距離與地形：嘉山在恆州曲陽縣東，倚太行山東麓；常山郡治在今正定，博陵郡治在今定州，沙河在行唐與新樂之間，行唐在常山郡治正定之北數十里，騎兵往來極便。
dataEn: The figures directly attached to this battle are those recorded in the Zizhi Tongjian and the Jiu Tangshu. Chronology: the An Lushan rebellion broke out in the eleventh month of the fourteenth year of Tianbao (755); in the first month of the fifteenth year (756) An Lushan proclaimed himself emperor at Luoyang and founded the Great Yan; in the fourth month of the same year Guo Ziyi and Li Guangbi defeated Shi Siming's general Li Lijie in the Battle of Jiumen; in the fifth month the Tang besieged Boling commandery for ten days without taking it and lifted the siege, and on the twenty-ninth day of that month they fought the decisive action at Jiashan, after which the situation in Hebei turned over quickly, until on the seventh day of the sixth month the Tang were routed at Tong Pass and Xuanzong fled west from Chang'an. Strength: on the Yan side, Shi Siming's own troops, the twenty thousand foot and horse under Cai Xide and the more than ten thousand mustered from Fanyang and the other prefectures by Niu Tingjie were merged into a force of more than fifty thousand, of whom about ten thousand were picked Tongluo and Yiluohe cavalry; on the Tang side only five hundred cavalry were committed during the delaying phase, while the main bodies of Guo Ziyi and Li Guangbi came out of the city for the decisive action, together with more than fifty thousand men of relief forces and of the Hebei prefectures that answered the call, though the detailed organisation of that force is not recorded. Result: forty thousand heads taken, more than a thousand prisoners, five hundred war-horses captured. Distance and terrain: Jiashan lay east of Quyang in Hengzhou, against the eastern foot of the Taihang; the seat of Changshan commandery was at present-day Zhengding, that of Boling at present-day Dingzhou; the Shahe ran between Xingtang and Xinle, and Xingtang lies a few dozen li north of the seat of Changshan, which made it a convenient distance for cavalry to move.
cause: 嘉山之戰是安史之亂在河北戰線的一次反攻與追擊戰，起因要從整場叛亂的鋪開說起。天寶十四載（755年）十一月，安祿山以奉密詔討楊國忠為名，自范陽起兵，河北諸州多望風而下；天寶十五載（756年）正月，安祿山在洛陽稱帝，建立大燕。叛軍主力由河北南下，直取洛陽與潼關，唐廷只能靠朔方、河東兩鎮的邊軍在河北抵抗。就在這年四月，郭子儀與李光弼在常山會師，於九門之戰擊敗史思明部將李立節，河北局勢一度為之振奮。史思明收拾殘兵退保博陵郡，唐軍乘勝追擊，圍城十日不能下，只好在五月撤圍。撤圍本是為避免久戰耗損，卻讓史思明抓住機會，率數萬人馬尾追而來，唐軍一旦被咬住，就可能在河北全軍覆沒，郭子儀遂以誘敵、疲敵的手段把追兵拖垮，這是嘉山之戰的直接起因。另一層起因在燕軍內部：安祿山在洛陽得到河北敗報後，急令蔡希德率步騎兵二萬北上回援，又命范陽守將牛廷玠徵發范陽等郡兵萬餘人南下，兩面夾擊的布置本身說明燕軍已把河北視為必須全力保住的根本，一旦再敗，洛陽與范陽之間的通道就會被切斷，叛軍就只能退守河南一隅。
causeEn: The Battle of Jiashan was a counter-offensive and pursuit fought by the Tang on the Hebei front of the An Lushan rebellion, and its causes have to be traced back to the way the rebellion spread. In the eleventh month of the fourteenth year of Tianbao (755), An Lushan rose at Fanyang under the pretext of carrying a secret imperial order to punish Yang Guozhong, and most of the prefectures of Hebei fell without a fight; in the first month of the fifteenth year (756) he proclaimed himself emperor at Luoyang and founded the Great Yan. The rebel main body moved south out of Hebei straight at Luoyang and Tong Pass, and the Tang court could only rely on the frontier troops of the Shuofang and Hedong circuits to hold the line in Hebei. In the fourth month of that year Guo Ziyi and Li Guangbi joined forces at Changshan and defeated Shi Siming's general Li Lijie in the Battle of Jiumen, which heartened the Hebei situation for a time. Shi Siming gathered his remnants and held Boling commandery; the Tang pressed the attack but could not take the city, and in the fifth month they had to lift the siege. Lifting the siege was meant to avoid wearing themselves out in a long war, but it handed Shi Siming his chance, and he followed the retiring Tang army with tens of thousands of men and horses; had the Tang been caught and pinned down, their whole army in Hebei might have been destroyed, so Guo Ziyi answered with feints, harassment and delay, dragging the pursuers until they were spent. That was the immediate cause of the battle at Jiashan. A second cause lay inside the Yan camp: once the news of the Hebei defeat reached Luoyang, An Lushan hurried Cai Xide north with twenty thousand foot and horse and ordered Niu Tingjie of Fanyang to muster more than ten thousand men and march south, so that the Yan would close in from two directions. That deployment itself shows how the Yan command had come to treat Hebei as the foundation it must hold at all costs, for a second defeat there would sever the road between Luoyang and Fanyang and leave the rebels able to hold nothing but Henan.
impact: 嘉山之戰的直接後果，是燕軍在河北的攻勢被壓住，唐軍第一次在野戰中把史思明打得大敗。史思明落馬披髮赤足、拖著斷槍逃回本營，隨即退往博陵，李光弼乘勝再圍博陵，郭子儀則打算北上進攻范陽。消息傳到河北，河北十餘郡的地方官吏與軍民紛紛起事，殺死叛軍守將，歸順唐軍；自顏杲卿在常山舉義以來被切斷的范陽至洛陽通道再次被打斷，叛軍往來的人只能輕裝簡從偷渡，結果多被唐軍俘獲。安祿山在范陽的家眷與河北的兵源因此人心浮動，軍心大受影響，他大罵謀士高尚、嚴莊，重新召集謀臣議事，一度打算放棄洛陽、退回范陽。從整場安史之亂來看，河北這次反攻的意義，是對叛軍戰略主軸的一次打擊：安史叛軍一直靠范陽的兵源與河北的地盤支撐，一旦河北各郡歸唐，叛軍就只能退守河南與洛陽一隅，再無法像先前那樣自河北向河南輸送兵源與糧秣。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of the Battle of Jiashan was that the Yan offensive in Hebei was checked, and the Tang won an open-field battle against Shi Siming for the first time. Shi Siming fell from his horse, went bareheaded and barefoot, dragged his broken spear back to his camp and withdrew towards Boling; Li Guangbi at once besieged Boling again, and Guo Ziyi prepared to march north on Fanyang. The news spread through Hebei, where the local officials, soldiers and common people of more than ten prefectures rose up, killed the Yan garrison commanders and went over to the Tang. The road from Fanyang to Luoyang, already cut since Yan Gaoqing raised troops at Changshan, was severed once more: rebels moving along it could now cross only in light disguise, and most of them were captured by the Tang. An Lushan's family in Fanyang and the Hebei manpower on which he depended were shaken to the core; he berated his advisers Gao Shang and Yan Zhuang, called a fresh council of his strategists, and for a time considered abandoning Luoyang and falling back to Fanyang. Seen against the whole of the An Lushan rebellion, the meaning of this counter-offensive in Hebei was a blow struck at the rebels' main strategic axis: the Yan forces had always been sustained by the manpower of Fanyang and the ground of Hebei, and once the prefectures of Hebei went over to the Tang, the rebels could only hold Henan and the neighbourhood of Luoyang, and could no longer pass troops and grain from Hebei into Henan as they had done before.
result: 五月二十九日嘉山一戰，唐軍大獲全勝，斬首四萬級，俘虜千餘人，繳獲戰馬五百匹，史思明所部主力在此役中受到重創。史思明在亂軍中跌下馬來，披髮赤足、拖著斷槍逃回軍營，隨即退往博陵郡，李光弼乘勝追擊，再次把博陵圍了起來；郭子儀則準備北上進攻范陽，直搗叛軍根本。河北十餘郡的地方官吏與軍民聞風響應，殺死叛軍守將歸順唐軍，叛軍從范陽到洛陽的通道再次被切斷，情報與補給只能靠輕裝偷渡維持，多半被唐軍俘獲，安祿山在范陽的軍眷與兵源因此人心浮動。史思明退保博陵，安祿山一度打算放棄洛陽、退回范陽，河北戰局由此扭轉。然而好景不長：六月初中唐軍在潼關被破，玄宗西幸長安，叛軍的危機由此解除，安史之亂反而捲入更長的僵持。嘉山之戰因此成為唐軍在河北最漂亮的一場野戰勝利之一，卻沒有成為扭轉亂局的契機。
resultEn: On the twenty-ninth day of the fifth month the battle at Jiashan was a complete Tang victory: forty thousand heads were taken, more than a thousand men captured and five hundred war-horses seized, and the main body of Shi Siming's army was badly mauled in it. Shi Siming fell from his horse in the confusion, went bareheaded and barefoot, dragged his broken spear back to his camp and then withdrew to Boling commandery; Li Guangbi followed up the victory and besieged Boling a second time, while Guo Ziyi prepared to march north on Fanyang and strike at the root of the rebellion. The local officials, soldiers and common people of more than ten Hebei prefectures answered the news by killing Yan commanders and going over to the Tang, and the road from Fanyang to Luoyang was cut again: rebel despatches and supplies could only be carried across it in light disguise, and most of the carriers were captured by the Tang, so that the mood among An Lushan's own household and manpower in Fanyang faltered. Shi Siming fell back on Boling, and An Lushan for a time considered giving up Luoyang and returning to Fanyang, so the situation in Hebei was turned around. But the turn did not last. In the first days of the sixth month the Tang were broken through at Tong Pass and Xuanzong fled west from Chang'an; the rebels' crisis was thereby relieved, and the An Lushan rebellion settled into a longer stalemate. The Battle of Jiashan therefore stands as one of the finest Tang field victories in Hebei, though it never became the turning point of the whole rebellion.
